column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Doubts Herself
Enough already!
You too, it's about time you remembered!
Rather, if we were to think about it calmly, is it really possible for me to lose only the memories of my gross otaku hobbies?
Huh?
Furthermore, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call me Japan's beautiful, multi-talented and most dazzling middle schooler right now and...*gasp gasp*
I-Isn't it just strange that I would lean towards gross otaku hobbies!?
The thing that's strange is your brain! To think that you could praise yourself until you need a breather!?
Because it's all true, right?
Certainly.
That's right! In other words, all these things must be yours! Come on, hurry up and tell the truth. If you do so now, you'll only need to leave this family
to obtain my forgiveness.
That isn't forgiveness at all!
These aren't mine. You can ask Dad if you have doubts.
That's... impossible.
Enough, leave!
Tch... In the end, it's the same as yesterday.
However, this has become troublesome.
Kirino's current impression of me has become that of an extreme siscon and perverted otaku bastard.
Well, on the other hand, there's nothing to be afraid of now that I've come this far. Unlike siscons elsewhere, I really hate my little sister, so I don't
really have a problem with being hated by her.
...Good grief, what should I do about this?
